recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5989 unless a future work group decision reintroduces separate systolic/diastolic Observation examples or changes component context semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-5989 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Observation correction reporting that the blood pressure example's parent Observation had a patient reference while the systolic and diastolic child Observations did not. The supporting comment stated that patient and other relevant context should be repeated on each occurrence.
initial_application: Commit 299efb1d489ff7c1ce5f99aa0c2f89c159b69dcd applied #5989 on 2015-03-27 by adding Patient/example subject references to both child Observations in source/observation/observation-example-bloodpressure.xml. No prior Issue-Reconcile audit commit for FHIR-5989 was present on the combined branch before this run.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/observation/list-Observation-examples.xml lists Observation/blood-pressure as a current example. Later commit 348f096acfd2c65b60b6ba759f214f756d403709 reintroduced Observation.component and converted the old three-Observation Bundle into one Observation with systolic and diastolic components. Current source has one Observation with subject, effectiveDateTime, performer, and two components; Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current component-based example has no child Observation resources on which patient references could be omitted.
